treatment_summary: The plan addresses ESRD with diabetic‑ischemic nephropathy, hypertension, ischemic heart disease, and anaemia. ACE‑I (ramipril) and statin (atorvastatin) are started per NG203 for renal protection and cardiovascular risk reduction. Iron repletion (ferric carboxymaltose) and ESA (epoetin alfa) target CKD‑related anaemia per NG107. Heart failure is managed with metoprolol and furosemide. Vitamin‑D analogue (alfacalcidol) and alkali therapy (sodium bicarbonate) are included pending relevant labs. All drugs are dosed for advanced CKD, with careful monitoring of renal function, electrolytes, and haemoglobin. Contraindicated agents (NSAIDs, metformin, SGLT2‑inhibitor, ACE‑I + ARB, high‑dose potassium, pioglitazone) are avoided. Ongoing monitoring aligns with NICE recommendations.
